# Cupertino Icons layer for Iumrah Android

This repository vendors a permanent Android-facing Cupertino icon layer under
`app/src/main/java/com/iumrah/beta/ui/cupertino/` so UI parity work does not
fall back to Material Icons.

The semantic naming follows the public Flutter `cupertino_icons` package and
iOS SF-style concepts. Android glyph geometry is rendered locally in Compose;
Apple SF Symbols binary assets are not redistributed.

Reference package: `cupertino_icons` 1.0.9 (MIT).
